verdict.rationale: Exa ships an agent product (Exa Agent), so a buyer could fairly ask whether it accepts external MCP servers; the axis applies. The pack shows no such client capability. All MCP evidence describes Exa acting as an MCP server for other clients, which is the opposite role. Exa Connect attaches only Exa's own curated data partners (e.g., ZoomInfo, Crunchbase), not user-supplied MCP servers, so it is an adjacent feature that earns no credit.
